address: Simon van Capelweg 10, Noorden, 2431 AG, Netherlands
bio: The walk alongside the canals affords a foretaste of what you can expect in this refurbished restaurant that enjoys a superb waterside location. The chef mixes classical recipes with generosity and modern textures. His culinary palette is diverse and intriguing and the formula is highly recommended. Enquire about overnight stays and boat trips (with a picnic basket) on the Nieuwkoopse Plassen....
